WITH budget_event_joined AS (
  SELECT 
    b.budget_id,
    b.spent,
    b.amount,
    b.link_to_event,
    e.event_id,
    e.type
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    type,
    AVG(CASE WHEN amount <> 0 THEN CAST(spent AS FLOAT) / amount END) as event_avg_rate
  FROM budget_event_joined
  GROUP BY event_id, type
),
type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    type,
    AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate
  FROM event_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(type_avg_rate) as mean_of_type_averages
  FROM type_rates
)
SELECT 
  t.type,
  t.type_avg_rate,
  t.type_avg_rate / o.mean_of_type_averages as rate_divided_by_mean
FROM type_rates t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
ORDER BY t.type
